text: まず　おもいきり　いきを　はいて　もうダメって　ほど　はきだしたら　しんせんな　くうきを　おおきく　すいこむの！

structure.jp: おもいきり　いきを　はいて
structure.en: breathe out as hard as you can, and

structure.jp: もうダメって　ほど　はきだしたら
structure.en: once you've let out so much you feel you can't any more

structure.jp: しんせんな　くうきを
おおきく　すいこむの！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'once that is done' or 'when that happens'. はきだしたら = 'once you have breathed it all out'.

patterns.name: 〜ほど
patterns.span: もうダメって　ほど
patterns.explanation: ほど shows how far something goes: 'to the point of'. って here is a casual という, quoting the feeling. もうダメって　ほど = 'to the point where you think I can't any more'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence is a soft, often girlish form of のだ, used when explaining something to someone. すいこむの = 'you breathe in, you see'.
